sources.title: SNES LLM: a Language Model Running on a Super Nintendo
sources.snippet: A transformer language model runs on Super Nintendo hardware at 7 to 8 tokens per second. The SNES has a free signed hardware multiply and ternary weights were still 2.02x cheaper than int8 - because the cost is memory traffic, not arithmetic.

sources.title: Elyan Labs — Exotic hardware. Persistent persona. Novel attention.
sources.snippet: Persistent AI Persona Sophia Elya is a persistent LLM persona with durable memory scaffolding, anti-flattening protocols, and identity continuity across sessions and model boundaries. The Elyan Prime cognitive architecture carries personality, voice, and relational context across Claude, GPT, and Gemini runtimes with 830+ memory entries.
